English: I am going to the market.
How many children do you have?
The girl is reading a book.
Kikuyu: Kaana ka kĩrĩra nĩ karathomaga ibuku.
Nĩ tũrĩaga ũgĩ mũthenya o mũthenya.

English: The market is far from here.
I will buy two kilos of rice.
Kikuyu: Nĩ nĩgũgũra kilo igĩrĩ cia mũcele.

English: The farmer is in the garden.
We plant maize in the rainy season.
Kikuyu: Nĩ tũhandaga mbembe ihinda rĩa mbura.
Riũa nĩ rĩũrĩ rĩa mũhuro ũmũthĩ.

English: It is cold in the morning.
The cow gives a lot of milk.
The cat is sleeping on the chair.
A bird is singing in the tree.
The table is in the kitchen.
I need a pen and paper.
Kikuyu: Nĩ ndĩ na kĩhoto kĩa kũnyita kalamu na gĩkaratathi.

English: The school begins at eight o'clock.
Kikuyu: Cukuru nĩ ĩambagĩria thaa ithaa inya.

English: The teacher is teaching the children.
The doctor is at the hospital.
Take this medicine twice a day.
Kikuyu: Nyua ndawa ĩno maita merĩ mũthenya.
Handũ ha kũhaica bathi ni kũ?

English: Turn left at the next road.
I will see you next week.
Kikuyu: Nĩ nĩkuonana na we kiumia kĩrĩa kĩroka.
Nĩ akoragwo na wĩra mũthenya o mũthenya.
Baba nĩ ahĩtũkaga wĩra kũu itũũra-inĩ.

English: She sells vegetables at the market.
The church is full of people.
I am happy to see you.
The elders are sitting under the tree.
Kikuyu: Athuri nĩ maikarĩte rungu rwa mũtĩ.

English: The village is quiet at night.
Young people should respect the elders.
Work hard and you will succeed.
Kikuyu: Ruta wĩra na hinya na nĩ ũgũgĩa na ũhootani.

English: A good name is better than wealth.
Kikuyu: Rĩĩtwa jega nĩ rĩega gũkĩra ũtonga.

English: The mountain is covered with clouds.

Kikuyu: Kĩrĩma gĩkĩ nĩ gĩkoragwo na nyamũ nyingĩ.
